Gaps and implications

Your client journey today: real trust, and one big step between a reel and a first session

1

Without a masterclass, there is no way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren’t ready for ongoing sessions with you yet.

2

And there is no way to find out who in your audience is actually ready, and a good fit, for it.

*95% is an industry estimate, not your data.

No first step

A big decision, made from a 60-second reel

Right now someone who relates to a reel goes straight to booking a session with a stranger. For a lot of people that’s the hardest step there is, so they keep watching and never book.

E-course

Coming Home has no front door

Your e-course lives in your website menu. I found nothing that walks a follower or a listener towards it, so the product you already built is waiting for people to stumble on it.

Reach

Reach rises and falls with each post

Your last 7 reels ranged from 1,276 to 10.2k views. With 11.2k followers, most of your audience doesn’t see a given post, and the podcast audience never sees your booking link at all unless they go looking.

People already trust your voice. There’s no gentle, low-pressure moment yet where they can meet the team and take the next step.

My recommendation

A free online workshop with Kat and Aimee, with Coming Home on the thank-you page

You already have a low-ticket product, so the workshop itself should be free. It’s education, not therapy: an hour of plain-language psychology in the voice people know from the podcast. Coming Home earns from day one and pays for the ads, and the replay page invites people to book your free 10-minute session.

Audience + adsInstagram 11.2k, the podcast, your newsletter, Meta ads
Free workshop“Why Did Nobody Tell Me How Anxiety Works?”
Coming Homeyour e-course, [$47] on the thank-you page
Get to know usfree 10-minute session, short intake first
Ongoing sessionswith the right practitioner

Gives people a first step

A free hour with you is the easiest yes for someone who isn’t ready to book. They hear how you think and talk, and every sign-up is an email you keep.

Puts Coming Home in front of people

Everyone who registers sees your e-course on the thank-you page, at the moment they’re most curious. That revenue covers the ad spend.

Spreads demand across the team

Kat’s books are closed until a 2027 waitlist. The workshop introduces the whole team, so new bookings flow to Aimee, Lisa and Maddie, who have availability.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready to book yet

They join the free workshop and many add Coming Home to keep learning at their own pace. Your newsletter and the podcast keep them close until they’re ready.

The ready 5%

Ready to talk to someone now

They stay to the end and book the free 10-minute session from the replay page. A short intake (state, funding, what they’d like support with) matches them to the right practitioner before the call.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Free online workshop with Kat + Aimee

Why did nobody tell me how anxiety works?

A free 60-minute workshop with psychologist Kat Wyeth and psychotherapist Aimee Hudson, the voices behind The Psychology Sisters podcast. What anxiety is, why it shows up, and everyday ways to care for yourself, explained in plain language.

Live on Zoom60 minutesReplay includedFree

The next workshop starts in

3Days
00Hrs
00Min
00Sec

Who it’s for

Life can get pretty hectic. We get it.

  • You want to understand what’s going on in your body and mind when stress builds.
  • You’d like simple, practical ideas you can use on a busy day.
  • You’re curious what talking to a psychologist is actually like, with no pressure to book.
  • You’re supporting a partner, friend or family member and want to understand them better.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in one hour

What anxiety actually is (and isn’t)

The body’s alarm system, explained in plain language, and why it can switch on when there’s no real danger.

Why it shows up when it does

The everyday things that turn the volume up: stress, sleep, big life changes, and the stories we tell ourselves.

Everyday care for your nervous system

Simple grounding and breathing practices that psychologists often share, and how to fit them into a normal day.

How to talk about it

Words that help when you want to explain what you’re feeling to a partner, a friend or your GP.

When extra support can help

What a first session with a psychologist looks like, how a Mental Health Care Plan works, and how to choose a practitioner.

Meet your hosts

Hi, we’re Kat + Aimee

We’re the directors of The Psych Collaborative, an online psychology practice supporting people Australia wide. Kat is a Senior Psychologist and Aimee is a Principal Clinical Psychotherapist, and we’ve been talking about the parts of life nobody warns you about on The Psychology Sisters since 2019.

Our practice is a safe space for you to feel heard, seen + understood. This workshop is our way of sharing what we know, for free, with anyone who wants to learn.

AHPRA + PACFA registered team146 podcast episodesOnline, Australia wide

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this therapy?

No. It’s a free educational workshop. If you’d like individual support afterwards, we’ll explain how to book a free 10-minute Get to know us session.

Will I have to share anything?

Not at all. Cameras can stay off, and questions in the chat can be anonymous. Judgement-free zone.

What if I can’t make it live?

Sign up anyway. Everyone who registers gets the replay.

Is it really free?

Yes. Come, listen, ask your questions, and decide afterwards. No pressure.

Questions

Good to know

What does a session cost?

Your initial assessment is $247.50 to $375 (80 minutes), then ongoing sessions are $165 to $225 (50 minutes), depending on your practitioner.

Can I use a Mental Health Care Plan?

Kat and Lisa accept MHCP rebates. Email your plan to admin@thepsychcollaborative.com.au before your first appointment.

Do I have to commit to ongoing sessions?

No. We’re pay-as-you-go, with no obligation to sign up for ongoing sessions.
